description: NaSm₃Ti₂(SbO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.59 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with six SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-47°. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four SmO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-47°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.03 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sm and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Sm, and two equivalent Sb atoms to form distorted ONaSmSb₂ tetrahedra that share corners with six ONaSmSb₂ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaSm₃ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sm, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Sm atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaSm₃ tetrahedra.
